item.title: Dyson-style Airwrap dupe lands on Wowcher for just £99 as Christmas shoppers rush for luxury gifts
item.description: A Dyson-style multi-styler for just £99 in the run-up to Christmas? Wowcher has dropped a huge saving on a luxury hair tool that shoppers say delivers big-night glamour without the big-ticket price. Move fast before the cheapest stock disappears.

item.title: Live Glasgow Barrowland version of The Pogues' Fairytale of New York to be released for the first time
item.description: Record producer Steve Lillywhite has gone back to an archive recording of Fairytale of New York at the Glasgow Barrowland and restored the live version, which will be released for the first time next week. He says “if Shane MacGowan was around today, I think he would approve of this live version.”

item.title: What Africa Cup of Nations delayed call up means for Celtic and Rangers players
item.description: Celtic and Rangers have been given an extra week with their AFCON eligible players this month

item.title: Christmas shoppers warned of chaotic delivery deadlines as first cut-off hits this week
item.description: Christmas shoppers are being urged to check post and courier deadlines now, with the first cut-off for overseas parcels landing this week and UK dates following fast.

item.title: Plans approved: Work to begin on regeneration of 200-acre former Ravenscraig Steelworks site
item.description: The regeneration of the former Ravenscraig Steelworks has reached a major milestone with the approval of extensive extraction and remediation works covering 200 acres of previously unusable land. This crucial phase is set to transform the site, preparing it for the delivery of a vibrant, self-sufficient new community.

item.title: This Ghost perfume was my first designer fragrance and its still my fave for Christmas
item.description: My favourite fragrance for the last thirty years is Ghost perfume - now on sale with 65% off.

item.title: Steve Lillywhite: I proposed to Kirsty MacColl in front of the Glasgow Barrowland
item.description: Before Kirsty MacColl joined The Pogues on stage for the first live rendition of Fairytale of New York, the venue was already a special place for the musician. Now Steve Lillywhite has recovered an archive recording of that piece of music history.
